UCKwQa5DB_VR98ac_r-Wyl-g.title: Mercaz Daf Yomi by R' Eli Stefansky
UCKwQa5DB_VR98ac_r-Wyl-g.description:
Welcome to Mercaz Daf Yomi Official channel!

Given to you by R' Eli Stefansky, We are dedicated to bringing you daily Daf Yomi but in an entertaining way, doing it one Daf at a time. Our goal is to provide an accessible and engaging way for people to learn and connect with the Daf.

Whether you are new to the Daf Yomi or have been studying it for years, we hope that our Shiur will be a valuable resource for you. 

Join us and many others around the world, as we do the Daf. 

Don't forget to subscribe to receive notifications whenever a new Shiur is out. We can't wait to learn with you!

Find More at https://mdydaf.com/
